title: Snowball media website
lede: The newsletter site of Snowball, the French personal-finance publisher behind the Fractal design system.
summary: Violet hero, heavy headline, and an outlined card with a hard shadow; borderline against the fingerprint.

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 25 September 2026 and inspected. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens. snowball.xyz redirected to media.snowball.xyz. A cookie banner covers the lower left of the screenshot.

styles.note: Applies Fractal on a production site: an outlined card with a hard shadow and flat pastel fields. It fails the fingerprint on 1 px outlines and some gradients.

observed: A flat pink navigation bar sits above a flat violet hero with a faint grid.
The headline is a heavy geometric sans-serif in black.
The signup card has a black outline and a solid black shadow. The subscribe button is a white pill with a black outline.
Small coin and banknote illustrations have black outlines.
A black band carries white statistics text.
interpretation: A moderate application of the style: the card and illustrations follow it, but the pill buttons and thin outlines soften it.

images.alt: Snowball media home page: a pink navigation bar, a violet hero with the heavy black headline “Le média qui t’apprend à investir sur le long terme”, an outlined signup card with a hard shadow, small outlined coin illustrations, and a cookie banner at lower left.
images.caption: First viewport of [media.snowball.xyz](https://media.snowball.xyz/).
